Born into a family of carpenters.

Constantin grew up in a mountain town in Romania, next to a furniture and lumber factory, in a family with generations of carpentry behind it. He had a gift for drawing and a love of woodwork from a child.

The promise on his site: "no mistakes or excuses, just outstanding craftsmanship." He fits doors and floors, first and second fix, and his decorators are on hand when the room needs paint.

  1. Mountain town, RomaniaGrew up beside a furniture and lumber factory.
  2. Trade school at 14A professional school for carpenters and joiners.
  3. Across EuropeWork in Greece, Italy, Switzerland and the UK.
  4. Today, LondonTen years of projects in London and around, alone or with teams of carpenters.
